@@ -397,27 +397,27 @@
 
 ### 4.6 Sample V3 (hybrid PQC)
 
-**Run:**
-
-```bash
-notes survey runtime ps-001-v3-sample --jfr --log-level debug --log-file "$HOME/notes-test/logs/ps-001-v3-sample.log" -- java -jar "$HOME/notes-test/sample-apps/ps-001-v3-sample-payment-gateway/target/ps-001-v3-sample-payment-gateway-1.0.0-v3.jar"
-```
-
-**Pass if the Dashboard shows (hybrid-PQC invariant):**
-
-- No `des` / `md5`.
-- **GREEN includes the post-quantum algorithms `ml-kem` and `ml-dsa`**: this is the key signal that the hybrid PQC path ran and was captured. (If GREEN has no `ml-kem`/`ml-dsa`, first suspect the JDK requirement above; a JDK 25 target silently drops them.)
-- Classical algorithms retained for the hybrid pairs (RSA, SHA256withRSA) still appear as YELLOW / TRANSITION; that is expected in hybrid mode.
-
-### 4.7 Sample V4 (PQC-first)
-
-**Run:**

-notes survey runtime ps-001-v4-sample --jfr --log-level debug --log-file "$HOME/notes-test/logs/ps-001-v4-sample.log" -- java -jar "$HOME/notes-test/sample-apps/ps-001-v4-sample-payment-gateway/target/ps-001-v4-sample-payment-gateway-1.0.0.jar"
-```
-

+**Run:** (checked)
+ (checked)
+```bash (checked)
+notes survey runtime ps-001-v3-sample --jfr --log-level debug --log-file "$HOME/notes-test/logs/ps-001-v3-sample.log" -- java -jar "$HOME/notes-test/sample-apps/ps-001-v3-sample-payment-gateway/target/ps-001-v3-sample-payment-gateway-1.0.0-v3.jar" (checked)
+``` (checked)
+ (checked)
+**Pass if the Dashboard shows (hybrid-PQC invariant):** (checked)
+ (checked)
+- No `des` / `md5`. (checked)
+- **GREEN includes the post-quantum algorithms `ml-kem` and `ml-dsa`**: this is the key signal that the hybrid PQC path ran and was captured. (If GREEN has no `ml-kem`/`ml-dsa`, first suspect the JDK requirement above; a JDK 25 target silently drops them.) (checked)
+- Classical algorithms retained for the hybrid pairs (RSA, SHA256withRSA) still appear as YELLOW / TRANSITION; that is expected in hybrid mode. (checked)
+ (checked)
+### 4.7 Sample V4 (PQC-first) (checked)
+ (checked)
+**Run:** (checked)
+ (checked)
+```bash (checked)
+notes survey runtime ps-001-v4-sample --jfr --log-level debug --log-file "$HOME/notes-test/logs/ps-001-v4-sample.log" -- java -jar "$HOME/notes-test/sample-apps/ps-001-v4-sample-payment-gateway/target/ps-001-v4-sample-payment-gateway-1.0.0.jar" (checked)
+``` (checked)
+ (checked)
+**Pass if the Dashboard shows (PQC-first invariant):** (checked)
